Record Class Board

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.adsl.server.model.board.Board
Record Components:
lowRow - the lower tribe-card row (cards moved from top row at end of round)
topRow - the upper tribe-card row (freshly drawn from deck each round)
offerTrack - the offer track where players place their totems to choose an action
orderTile - the turn-order track that determines player sequence
remainingBuildings - building decks queued for future eras (era 2 at index 0, era 3 at index 1)
deck - the shuffled draw pile of tribe cards and events
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public record Board(CardRow lowRow, CardRow topRow, OfferTrack offerTrack, OrderTile orderTile, ArrayList<Set<Card>> remainingBuildings, Deck deck) extends Record implements Serializable
Immutable record holding all board components for a game session.
